description: Graph components follow each product's brand (Sami, 15 Nov): one theme per host, light and dark. The roles are the same for every host; only the values change. Web only (Sami, 15 Nov): these generate src/generated/themes.ts and generated/themes.css, never Swift or Rust. The categorical series orders were checked with the dataviz palette validator (lightness band, chroma floor, adjacent CVD separation, normal-vision floor) against each theme's ground; the light ones warn below 3:1 contrast for some slots, which is why every chart with two or more series has a legend.

roles.ground: The chart's surface: the ring around dots and markers, label halos, the standalone background. Charts in a page draw no background of their own.
roles.panel: Raised chrome: the tooltip, the map legend; a path's casing and start-marker fill.
roles.ink: Primary text: titles, labels at marks, tooltip values.
roles.soft: Secondary text: tick labels, legend entries, axis names.
roles.axis: The axes through zero, the baseline, the plot's edge.
roles.accent: The one mark colour: a single series, a solid path, the default point.
roles.series: Categorical marks, in this fixed order, never cycled (at most 6 series).
roles.up: A price that rose (candle, volume bar). Never alone: rising candles are hollow, falling ones filled.
roles.buildings: Extruded buildings under a path on the map.
roles.sequential: One hue, low to high value.
roles.diverging: Two poles around a neutral middle.

ava.description: Ava (the app's chat and search.heyava.ca): the ava brand book's Lilac and Night, the violet accent, DM Sans and IBM Plex Mono (avacanada/ava-site brand.ts). The ramps are the ones Sami chose for ava's maps on 13-14 Nov (avacanada/ava-web lib/path-on-map.ts).

zega.description: zega.dev and zega.earth: the paper ground, the green accent (zegadb/site globals.css), Space Grotesk and IBM Plex Mono. The sequential ramp is a new green one (a proposal until Sami approves it); the diverging ramp is the explorer's.
